work_done: Built E103-repro-viewcount prototype (e103_repro.py) - independent re-run of Hex.pm view-count experiment
Prototype classifies Hex.pm packages as need-related vs infrastructure using description analysis
Key finding: G4 gate (view_count > 0 ≥ 95%) fails on Hex.pm (99/200 = 49.5% have downloads > 0)
Cliff's δ ≈ 0.03 (near-zero effect: need-related and infrastructure packages have similar download rates)
Compared with E101: principle passes G4 on Discourse forums (100% view_positive_rate)
Identified boundary condition: principle's G4 gate requires platforms where most items have view/download counts > 0

key_claims.viewcount_boundary_g4: The view-count principle's G4 gate (≥ 95% view_count > 0) is a platform filter - it passes on forums where all topics have been viewed (Discourse) but fails on package registries where not all packages have downloads (Hex.pm)
key_claims.cliff_delta_near_zero: Need-related and infrastructure packages on Hex.pm have statistically indistinguishable download rates (Cliff's δ = 0.03), contradicting E103's reported 220x median ratio effect
key_claims.classifier_conservative: The prototype's classification rubric catches 22/200 need-related packages (conservative lower bound); original E103 caught 100/200 with human/aided classification
